action/primaryContent: Text and icons on primary buttons
action/secondaryContent: Text and icons on secondary buttons
action/tertiaryContent: Text and icons on tertiary buttons
action/tertiaryBorder: Tertiary (outlined) button border — keeps the button's fill/content/border trio in one namespace so they move together
action/destructiveContent: Text and icons on destructive buttons
action/disabledContent: Text and icons on disabled buttons
action/ghostContent: Text and icons on ghost buttons
input/error: Input error border and message color
tabBar/border: Top divider between tab bar and screen content
tabBar/itemActive: Active tab bar item label and icon
tabBar/itemInactive: Inactive tab bar item label and icon (replaces legacy Gray 450)
badge/notificationBackground: Notification badge fill (red dot on tab bar, avatar, icons)
badge/notificationBorder: Notification badge border — matches the surface behind the badge to create the "hole" ring effect
badge/notificationContent: Text and icons inside notification badges
badge/countBackground: Neutral count badge fill (unread counts, cart totals, non-urgent counters)
card/background: Default card fill (content cards, list-group cards, currency cards)
card/backgroundElevated: Elevated card fill (cards that float above the base surface)
card/border: Card border — use in place of border/subtle or border/default when outlining cards
